$comment: Hawkes's own games on Hawkes Net (docs/net.md 'Projects and accounts'). Every other project is made by an account on net.hawkesgen.com and kept by the service (net_projects); an admin takes these into their account there (settings changed there sit over this file). No project, no tickets. origins: pages that may ask for player tickets with no key (the public door; http://localhost and 127.0.0.1 are always allowed). keyProjects: Gen key project patterns that may make tickets for this project besides keys for the project itself (the portal's key works in usr_* projects). transports: what the project may use. defaults: the room config a ticket starts a room with (a request's config is clamped to it). limits: per project. testPrefix: rooms named so are playtests: free and not counted in totals.

hawkesgenwebsite.name: Hawkes Gen Portal
hawkesgenwebsite.$comment: No origins: every ticket for the portal's rooms comes from the portal itself (its key), after its own checks (edit tokens, hidden worlds, invitations). An Origin header can be set by anyone outside a browser, so the door would let them into any room here.

netdemo.name: Hawkes Net demo
netdemo.$comment: The demo shows a room moving from peer to peer to the relay, so it keeps peer to peer on.

doseofdestruction.name: Dose Of Destruction
doseofdestruction.$comment: A fighting game (docs/net.md 'Express'; DoD docs/online.md): one shared lobby room on the relay ('lobby' on doseofdestruction.com, 't-lobby' on beta and localhost) for presence and the queue, and a pair room per match ('m/<hash>', topology pair) that starts peer to peer (a direct link between the two browsers: the lowest latency) and moves to the relay when they can't link. Inputs go as express frames (rollback netcode). The leaderboard's signed results are records.

sickofit.name: Sick Of It
sickofit.$comment: The ghost lobby: everyone playing is in one room ('lobby' on sickofitgame.com, 't-lobby' on beta and in playtests; 'lobby-2'... when full). Poses only: the floor rides in z (level x 1000), so other floors are far and come rarely.

yoobaland.name: Yooba Land
yoobaland.$comment: An MMO (J, 2026-10-26: everyone in the same lobby; always on our servers): one room per area for everyone ('p1/lobby', 'p1/level-1' on yoobalandgame.com; 't-p1/...' on beta, 't-<id>/p1/...' in playtests; '.2', '.3'... past 250: avatars are compared per pair until the grid index is built, docs/net.md), on the relay only. Avatars ride the pose channel: every send within 60 m, 5 a second to 240 m, once a second past that.
